evidence.quote: In particular, the Committee is prepared to provide additional monetary accommodation through unconventional measures if it proves necessary, especially if the outlook were to deteriorate significantly.
I believe that additional purchases of longer-term securities, should the FOMC choose to undertake them, would be effective in further easing financial conditions.
Incoming data on the labor market have remained disappointing.
Recently, inflation has declined to a level that is slightly below that which FOMC participants view as most conducive to a healthy economy in the long run.
First, the FOMC will strongly resist deviations from price stability in the downward direction.
Second, regardless of the risks of deflation, the FOMC will do all that it can to ensure continuation of the economic recovery.

parsed.rationale: The speech describes slowing growth, a disappointing labor market and below-target inflation. It lays out further easing options, especially additional asset purchases, while committing to resist disinflation and support the recovery, which is a clear dovish signal.
